title: Recurrence (entity)
description: The SHARED recurrence entity: a rule + anchor; occurrences are instantiations linked by native recurrence_of. Generalizes the previously-undocumented finance Recurrence entity type (already whitelisted in BASELINE_ENTITY_TYPES) — one type, tada series and finance recurring transactions the first conformers, gcal patterns the candidate third. Instantiation links are named recurrence_of deliberately — NOT recurrence_id, which in iCalendar means the RECURRENCE-ID property (which instance was modified), different semantics. Storage merges provider metadata FLAT into entity.data: source (natural-key half), etag (no-op field), source_status (pattern lifecycle: 'ended' | absent — a Recurrence DOES carry it; its lifecycle ends by stamping, unlike Task, which ends by conversion), tada_source.

source_id.description: Native pattern id (tada template uid). Natural key: (source, source_id).

kind.description: Conventions 'task' | 'event' (tada); other sources extend per source vocabulary.

rrule.description: RRULE text, verbatim from the source.

start_at.description: Anchor slot (ISO 8601 UTC); absent = slot-less pattern.
